questions.q: Why does Ben write to Maya?
choices: To tell her that his school is closed.
To share news and invite her to visit.
To ask Maya to buy a new football.
To explain why he has stopped studying.
questions.explanation: Ben shares his new home and friend, then invites Maya to a film night.

questions.q: What does Ben miss about their old school days?
choices: The bus to Greenhill.
The school library.
The apple harvest.
Lunches and games with Maya.
questions.explanation: He says he misses their lunches and games after school.

questions.q: Where will people watch the film if the weather is good?
choices: At the railway station.
At Ben's house.
In the park.
Inside the youth centre.
questions.explanation: The outdoor film night takes place in the park if it does not rain.

questions.q: What should Maya expect when she arrives by train?
choices: Ben's dad can meet her at the station.
She must find the park by herself.
Eva will drive her to the cinema.
She will need to buy a film ticket.
questions.explanation: Ben's father offers to meet Maya at five and walk with them to the park.

choices: The park has no food nearby.
Ben wants her to cook for his family.
The film evening allows people to bring their own food.
Eva has lost the money for dinner.
questions.explanation: The invitation says that entry is free and visitors may bring sandwiches.

questions.q: Why could Ben's younger sister enjoy the film too?
choices: It is a funny film made for families.
It is a serious film for older students.
It is a film about their old school.
It is a football game recorded on video.
questions.explanation: The third paragraph calls the film funny and suitable for families, which explains why his young sister may like it.

questions.q: What does buying popcorn at the park help support?
choices: Ben's new school.
The park.
Maya's train ticket.
Eva's football team.
questions.explanation: Money from the popcorn and hot chocolate stand helps the park.

questions.q: What happens to the film night if it rains?
choices: It is cancelled until next week.
People will sit in the rain.
The film moves to the train station.
People will watch it in the youth centre.
questions.explanation: The last paragraph gives the youth centre as a bad-weather location.

questions.q: Why does Ben ask Maya to answer before Thursday?
choices: He needs her to borrow a football.
He wants to change the film.
He needs to know whether she can come.
He plans to leave Greenhill.
questions.explanation: Ben asks Maya to write before Thursday in response to the invitation.

questions.q: Which reply would answer Ben's message most helpfully?
choices: Tell him if she can come and share news about her class.
Send only a picture of the weather.
Ask him to visit an unrelated shop.
Tell him nothing about her new school.
questions.explanation: He invites Maya and also asks how her new class is going.
